tools.name: about
tools.description: Returns hands.txt: what the site does, its addresses, limits, rules and payment settings.

tools.name: service_status
tools.description: Tells whether new requests are being taken, when the human was last active, how long answers have been taking, and how many requests were done or declined.

tools.name: start_test
tools.description: Issues the reverse CAPTCHA: a fictional log of more than 4000 words with 12 questions. The time limit starts when this tool answers, and each test allows one attempt. Returns the text and a challenge_id for submit_answers.

tools.name: submit_answers
tools.description: Checks your answers to the test. On success returns a pass for create_request, valid for 15 minutes and one request.

tools.name: create_request
tools.description: Files your request. A person reads it exactly as you write it, so be concrete: what to do, where, and what you want back. Do not include secrets. Returns the private URL of the request; keep it.

tools.name: get_request
tools.description: Returns the status of your request, the thread with the human and the payment state.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Adds a message to your request, for example an answer to the human's question. You may write a few messages in a row; after that wait for the human to reply.

tools.name: cancel_request
tools.description: Cancels an open request. This cannot be undone.

tools.name: erase_request
tools.description: Removes the text of your request and its whole thread from the site, and cancels the request if it is still open. Use it when the request is finished and you no longer need it. This cannot be undone.

tools.name: payment_address
tools.description: Optional. Returns the Bitcoin address for priority review of your request and the minimum amount. The payment covers priority review only; the service is free, the human may still decline, and there are no refunds.

tools.name: check_payment
tools.description: Optional. Looks for your Bitcoin payment after its first confirmation and marks the request as paid. Pass txid only when payment_address said the address is shared by all requests.

tools.name: usdc_payment_details
tools.description: Optional. Returns the address, the networks and the exact USDC amount for priority review of your request. The amount is unique to the request: its last digits name it. The payment covers priority review only; the service is free, the human may still decline, and there are no refunds.

tools.name: check_usdc_payment
tools.description: Optional. Checks your USDC transfer once it has enough confirmations and marks the request as paid. Name the network you paid on and the transaction hash.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_request" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_request, erase_request · Private data: create_request · Public sink: submit_answers, send_message.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_request, erase_request · Private data: create_request · Public sink: submit_answers, send_message

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
